COMMENT: Config for the REPORTED model, v6-0714 -- the run behind the README results table. The eval scripts under extra_scripts/swin/ default to this file, so they evaluate the reported model with no arguments. Training keeps its own config at scripts/new_enscgp_swin_config.json; do NOT point training at this file, because its log_dir is this run's directory and a new run would overwrite these checkpoints. The 'model' section is the v6 architecture, confirmed from this run's own training log (runs/0714/train_*.log); scripts/new_enscgp_swin.py can no longer build it (v6 has offset_gate, which the current class dropped), so the eval harness autodetects the architecture from the checkpoint and loads the pinned class from extra_scripts/swin/oneoff/_v6_0714_arch/.
